clue.text: Where you'll see another's swimming?

indicators.note: letters that are swimming move about freely, so the word another's is rearranged

parts.note: the S of the possessive counts as a letter here

explanation.surface: A riddle about where you might spot somebody else taking a dip.
explanation.walkthrough: 'swimming' rearranges ANOTHERS, apostrophe dropped, and the whole clue also describes the sea where you'd see someone swimming.
explanation.definitionFit: This body of water off Britain's east coast is a place where people, and fish, swim.

clue.text: A new creative skill, endlessly stylish, following no rules

indicators.note: endlessly means the last letter of the word is cut off

parts.note: art is a creative skill
chic means stylish

explanation.surface: A new artistic talent, fashionable without end, breaks all the rules.
explanation.walkthrough: 'endlessly' cuts ART down to AR.
explanation.definitionFit: Something anarchic is lawless and disorderly, obeying no rules at all.

clue.text: Location of butts? Hard to come in off-target here

indicators.note: to come in tells us one letter goes inside the other word

parts.note: a shot that goes astray is off-target
H is the pencil abbreviation for hard

explanation.surface: On a shooting range, the butts are where hard shots that miss come in.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Butts' suggests the targets on a rifle range, but here they are cigarette ends.
explanation.definitionFit: Cigarette butts are stubbed out and collected in a small dish for smokers' ash.

clue.text: Performance alone putting off special dancing partner

parts.note: a gig is a musical performance

indicators.note: putting off means the named letter is removed

parts.note: solo means alone

explanation.surface: A solo performance is put aside for a special dancing partner.
explanation.walkthrough: 'putting off' removes the S (special) from SOLO, leaving OLO.
explanation.definitionFit: A gigolo is a man paid to be a woman's escort, originally a professional dancing partner.

clue.text: Reward for good behaviour in position supporting secretary

indicators.note: in a down answer the supporting piece sits below the other

parts.note: PA, personal assistant, is a secretary
a role is a position or job

explanation.surface: A job backing up a secretary is offered as a reward for good conduct.
explanation.walkthrough: 'supporting' puts ROLE beneath PA in this down entry.
explanation.definitionFit: Prisoners may be released early on licence as a reward for behaving well inside.

clue.text: Give notice of talk about love presented by Christian philosopher

indicators.note: about means the word goes around the other pieces

parts.note: to prate is to talk foolishly at length
love is zero in tennis, hence the letter O
a Gnostic was an early Christian mystic philosopher

explanation.surface: An announcement about love delivered by a religious thinker.
explanation.walkthrough: 'presented by' only joins the pieces; 'about' is the container signal.
explanation.definitionFit: To prognosticate is to foretell or forecast, giving warning of what is to come.

clue.text: Workplan is developed with an opening for serious work assessment?

indicators.note: developed means the letters are worked up into a new form
the opening for a word is its first letter

explanation.surface: A work plan is drawn up with a chance to do some serious work.
explanation.walkthrough: 'developed' rearranges WORKPLANIS plus AN plus S, the first letter of serious, which is picked by 'opening for'.
explanation.definitionFit: The principle says work expands to fill the time available: a wry verdict on how work gets done.

clue.text: Dog in US side street, running

parts.note: in American billiards and pool, side (spin put on the ball) is called english

indicators.note: running means the letters are set in motion and rearranged

explanation.surface: A dog is seen running along an American side street.
explanation.walkthrough: 'running' rearranges STREET to SETTER. 'US side' is the American word for spin put on a ball in pool.
explanation.definitionFit: This is a breed of gundog, a long-haired, white-coated setter.

clue.text: College assessor in a hole

parts.note: a rater is someone who assesses or values

explanation.surface: A college examiner finds himself in a difficult hole.
explanation.definitionFit: A crater is a bowl-shaped hollow or pit in the ground.

clue.text: Comprehensive, albeit harsh

parts.note: tho, short for though, means albeit
rough means harsh

explanation.surface: A judgement described as complete, though severe.
explanation.definitionFit: A thorough job is complete and detailed, leaving nothing out.

clue.text: Complain when parking's not available for this?

definitions.text: Complain when parking's not available for this?

indicators.note: not available means the letter for parking goes missing

parts.note: to carp is to complain
P is the road-sign abbreviation for parking

explanation.surface: A driver grumbles about the vehicle when there is nowhere to park.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue doubles as the definition: what you moan about when no parking space is free.
explanation.definitionFit: A motorist with nowhere to leave the vehicle complains on its account.

clue.text: Construction system leading to school of no real quality

indicators.note: leading to puts the first piece ahead of the next

parts.note: a kit is a set of parts for building something

explanation.surface: A building set that leads to a school without real merit.
explanation.definitionFit: Kitsch describes art or decor that is gaudy and tasteless, lacking genuine worth.

clue.text: A cut's the reverse of excellent, entrenching one's hair problem

parts.note: to lop is to cut off

indicators.note: entrenching means digging one piece in inside another
the reverse of means the word is read backwards

parts.note: ace means excellent
I is the roman numeral one

explanation.surface: A haircut that is anything but excellent creates a hair problem.
explanation.walkthrough: 'the reverse of' turns ACE to ECA, and 'entrenching' puts I inside that, giving ECIA.
explanation.definitionFit: Alopecia is a medical condition causing hair loss, often in patches.

clue.text: Stop him snatching letter

indicators.note: the phrase snatches the answer, holding it within its letters

explanation.surface: A command to stop a man who is grabbing a letter.
explanation.walkthrough: 'snatching' signals the letters held across 'Stop him'.
explanation.definitionFit: Phi is the twenty-first letter of the Greek alphabet.

clue.text: Question expert about number sceptically

parts.note: to ask is to question

indicators.note: about means the word goes around the other letter

parts.note: an ace is an expert

explanation.surface: Questioning an expert on a figure, in a doubting manner.
explanation.definitionFit: To look askance is to regard with suspicion or doubt.

clue.text: Point where ditch runs uphill

indicators.note: in a down answer, running uphill means read from bottom to top

parts.note: to bin something is to ditch or throw it away

explanation.surface: A spot where a ditch climbs up a slope.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Ditch' looks like a noun, but it is the verb 'to discard'.
explanation.definitionFit: A nib is the pointed writing tip of a pen.

clue.text: Couple mostly irritated and nervous

indicators.note: mostly means all but the final letter is kept

parts.note: a couple is two
itchy skin is irritated

explanation.surface: A pair, both mostly annoyed and on edge.
explanation.walkthrough: 'mostly' trims TWO to TW.
explanation.definitionFit: Twitchy means jumpy, anxious and on edge.

clue.text: Show pride, with broadcast talk breaking barrier

indicators.note: breaking means one piece cuts into the middle of the other

parts.note: a wall is a barrier

indicators.note: broadcast scatters the letters of talk into a new order

explanation.surface: Showing pride while a broadcast speech breaks through a wall.
explanation.walkthrough: 'broadcast' gives the anagram KTAL, which 'breaking' splits the barrier with.
explanation.definitionFit: To walk tall is an idiom for holding your head high, proud and confident.

clue.text: Cat and bird severed by a chopper

indicators.note: severed by means the pair is split apart by the inserted letter

parts.note: a tom is a male cat
a hawk is a bird of prey

explanation.surface: A cat and a bird are cut apart by an axe.
explanation.walkthrough: 'severed by' means the single letter splits the two animals apart rather than sitting at either end.
explanation.definitionFit: A tomahawk is a light axe, a tool for chopping.

clue.text: Unknown exercises involved in scheme for recreational area

indicators.note: involved in means these letters are wrapped inside another word

parts.note: a plan is a scheme
Y is a mathematical unknown
PE is physical education, exercises

explanation.surface: Exercises of some unknown kind are part of a plan for a leisure area.
explanation.definitionFit: A playpen is a small enclosure where an infant can play safely.

clue.text: Alcoholic drink, new, featured in broadcast dance event

indicators.note: featured in means the letter appears inside the word

parts.note: to broadcast seed is to sow it
a ball is a formal dance

explanation.surface: A new cocktail appears at a televised dance.
explanation.walkthrough: 'broadcast' is the scattering of seed, not a TV transmission.
explanation.definitionFit: This is a cocktail of advocaat and lemonade, popular at Christmas.

clue.text: Our team's getting on top of nasty crop pest

indicators.note: in a down answer, the piece on top comes first

parts.note: our team is us, or we
evil means nasty

explanation.surface: Our side is gaining the upper hand over a horrible crop pest.
explanation.definitionFit: A weevil is a small beetle that damages grain and crops.

clue.text: Starts to apply points about power following article

indicators.note: following puts the next piece after the first

parts.note: A is the indefinite article

indicators.note: about means the word goes around the letter

parts.note: dots are points
P is the physics symbol for power

explanation.surface: Instructions on beginning to apply dots around power after an article.
explanation.definitionFit: To adopt a method is to take it up and begin to use it.

clue.text: Agile mountaineer, knocking top off

indicators.note: knocking the top off means the first letter goes

parts.note: a mountaineer is a climber

explanation.surface: A nimble mountaineer knocks a summit off.
explanation.definitionFit: Limber means lithe and supple, able to move easily.

clue.text: Boat that could create diversion if taken to lake

indicators.note: the boat would make the diversion if a letter were taken to it, so that letter is removed

parts.note: a lark is a bit of fun or a diversion

explanation.surface: A boat that might make a fun diversion when brought to a lake.
explanation.walkthrough: The clue works backwards: add L to the answer and you get LARK, so the answer is LARK without its L.
explanation.definitionFit: Noah's ark was the great vessel that carried the animals through the Flood.

clue.text: A lot of blood evident in passage in symbolic narrative

indicators.note: evident in means one piece shows up inside another

parts.note: an alley is a narrow passage

indicators.note: a lot of means most of the word, its last letter dropped

parts.note: gore is spilt blood

explanation.surface: Lots of blood is seen in a passage of a symbolic story.
explanation.walkthrough: 'A lot of' drops the final letter of the blood word; 'evident in' places the result inside the passage.
explanation.definitionFit: An allegory is a story whose characters and events stand for deeper meanings.

clue.text: Island group a success in time after the writer leaves

indicators.note: in means these letters go inside the other piece
leaves means the writer's word departs from time

parts.note: taken as written before the deletion
the writer refers to the setter, me
a hit is a success

explanation.surface: A band of islanders has a hit once the author departs.
explanation.walkthrough: 'the writer' is the setter, so 'leaves' removes the setter's word for himself from time, leaving TI.
explanation.definitionFit: Tahiti is the main Pacific island of French Polynesia, a name loosely applied to its island group.

clue.text: Informant starts to supply tip-off in time spent on phone

indicators.note: in means these letters go inside the other word

parts.note: a while is a period of time

indicators.note: the starts to these words are their opening letters

parts.note: the blower is British slang for the telephone

explanation.surface: An informant begins handing over a tip-off during a long phone call.
explanation.walkthrough: 'starts to' gives S and T, placed 'in' WHILE. 'Blower' is old British slang for the telephone.
explanation.definitionFit: A whistleblower exposes wrongdoing within an organisation to outsiders.
